rating_note: Goals per game better than an average team, adjusted for who each team played (SRS, shootout goal included). Early in the season last season's rating counts as 10 games, pulled 40% toward average.
source: NHL box scores (skaters only; no goalies) and final scores from the NHL's public API. Unofficial; regular season and playoffs only.
player_note: Regular season: totals, per game (P/GP, SOG/GP) and average minutes on ice (TOI).
